duplicates.notes: No independent published cheddar-only baked crisp with smoked paprika was found in the recipe library.

ingredients.notes: 140 g cheddar and 1 g smoked paprika, all weighed. The illustrated portion shows three thin cheese crisps.

method.notes: Spread 12 separate shallow mounds and bake at 200 °C to a golden edge. Cool on the parchment to let the cheese set crisp.

food_safety.notes: Milk allergen is disclosed. Use oven-safe parchment and let hot melted cheese cool before handling.

servings_and_time.notes: Twelve pieces and four portions of three each. The 25 minutes include oven heating, baking and cooling.

nutrition.notes: Fineli 698 is source-bound. Paprika is a documented bounded omission and rendered cheese fat remains a disclosed estimate.

glycemic.notes: There is no approved glycemic load calculation for this recipe. GK is marked undetermined.
